audience: vacation rental hosts who manage reservations, rates and guest messages in Smoobu

useCases.title: See who arrives soon and where
useCases.text: The AI lists reservations across channels filtered by arrival date or property. It shows guest, dates, channel, price and payment status.

useCases.title: Find open properties for dates and quote the price
useCases.text: The AI checks which properties can be booked between an arrival and a departure date, with the total price. It tells why others are not available.

useCases.title: Read guest conversations and draft a reply
useCases.text: The AI reads the inbox threads and the full conversation of a reservation. It can also read the placeholder values such as dates and check-in link to prepare a message.

useCases.title: Break down a reservation's price
useCases.text: The AI lists the price elements of a reservation: base price, cleaning fee, add-ons, discounts and coupons with amounts and tax.

useCases.title: Set rates, create or update bookings, or message guests
useCases.text: The AI sets nightly prices and minimum stays, creates or updates a reservation, or sends a message to a guest. Rate changes reach channels with price sync on.
